content.short: CoinsDo provides visibility into fund transfers, controls who can authorize them, and ensures only the right person can transfer funds for non-custodial digital assets.
content.description: CoinsDo delivers clear visibility into how funds move between addresses, allowing you to trace transfers and understand the flow of assets. It also offers flexible governance over who is authorized to initiate those transfers, enabling teams or individuals to define and adjust decision rights. Built with security at the forefront, CoinsDo aims to ensure that only the designated person or role can approve and execute transfers for non-custodial digital assets. This combination helps reduce misrouting and unauthorized activity while keeping tight control over funds.
content.meta: CoinsDo provides infrastructure security for non-custodial digital assets. Discover CoinsDo and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
